title: Paddington in Peru
about: Paddington and the Browns head to Peru to find Aunt Lucy, who has gone missing from the Home for Retired Bears.
cue: Serve the marmalade sandwiches when Paddington pulls one from under his hat.
faces: I've packed a marmalade sandwich for everyone, and a spare under my hat for emergencies.
Grilled sandwiches of thick-cut marmalade, ham and cheddar.
Lime and ají amarillo mashed potato layered with shredded chicken.
Choclo with queso fresco and ají sauce
The corn of the Peruvian Andes.
The Reverend Mother's welcome, songs included.
Wok-seared beef, red onion and tomato with soy, over crisp fries.
Ají de gallina with rice and egg
A creamy Peruvian chicken dish for the family.
Crumbly shortbread cookies sandwiched with dulce de leche.
Purple corn drink simmered with pineapple, cinnamon and clove.
A tray charge applies to every order. Prices subject to change. Every drink is alcohol free. The Hard Stare. Aunt Lucy in the Home. Form RS 32. Images: TMDB.
